thread:
Sam: Quick drop 1:1 goal template for sprint self-reviews — ultra short so people actually finish them. Pasteable below.

Priya: Love the brevity. Can you include a manager-facing variant too?

Sam: Yep. Core one-liner bundle (3 lines + optional ask/blocker):
```
Goal: <one-line statement of work>
Outcome: <one-line metric or customer impact>
Evidence: - <single concise bullet, include link if needed>
Ask (opt): <what you need from manager/peers>
Blocker (opt): <one-line risk>
```

Ava: Suggest replacing "Why it matters" language with "Outcome" to keep it metric-focused.

Sam: Swapped to Outcome. Also added a one-line peer feedback prompt for async reviews:
"Observed: <impact>. Example: <specific example>. Suggest: <one concrete next step>."

HR-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/one-line-goal-cheatsheet.pdf (org access) :white_check_mark:

Priya: Perfect. I'll distribute to managers and include in the next calibration packet.

Sam: If folks want a promotion-evidence version (one sentence + artifact link), reply and I'll add it as a second micro-slide.
